subject: Civic Education
lesson: Explains the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions: Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.3
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions.
Explains the importance of providing efficent service of the officers of public services identifying the need.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: The teacher writes or reads “Explains the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions” and asks students to name one example they have seen in everyday life. Students share brief responses; the teacher connects their examples to Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.3 and explains how it will help them explore this period's outcome.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher delivers prompts/cue cards; students inspect tasks.
Students use courtroom / citizen grievance tribunal to explore 'Explains the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions.'
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision.

summary: Synthesize key student findings from Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.3, emphasizing the core principles of “Explains the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions” and clarifying any lingering misconceptions.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Use the student's five-minute assignment response to check understanding of “Explains the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions” and give one concise correction or affirmation.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Each student completes a short exit response explaining one finding about “Explains the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions” using evidence or an example from Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.3. The teacher reviews responses for an accurate link to the period outcome.
selected_activity:
Activity: Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.3
Approach: Students use courtroom / citizen grievance tribunal to explore 'Explains the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions.'. Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: A short role-based civic decision and its reasons.
Grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
